name: hubspot-conversations-mcp
description: Read and send HubSpot Conversations messages: threads, replies, inboxes, channels, actors and custom channels.
long_description: MCP server for the HubSpot Conversations API (24 tools). Retrieve and filter conversation threads, read message history, send replies and internal comments, manage thread status, and integrate custom channels (publish external messages, delivery status, channel accounts).

hubspot_access_token.title: HubSpot service key
hubspot_access_token.description: Service key (pat-..., created under Development → Keys → Service Keys) with the conversations.read and conversations.write scopes (plus conversations.custom_channels.* for custom channel tools). Legacy private app tokens also work.

default_sender_actor_id.title: Default sender actor ID
default_sender_actor_id.description: Optional. Used as sender for SendConversationMessage when not passed explicitly, e.g. A-12345 (A-<your HubSpot user id>).
